ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisite will be enforced. This section will open to all students in the College of Business and to Food Science & Human Nutrition majors on Monday, April 20, 2015 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This section will open to Technical Systems Management and Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering students on Monday, May 4, 2015 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor admitted prior to January 2013.
